name: WeaverRidge Golf Club
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from course_data/library/weaver_ridge/card_review.json, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Black, Gold. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: 7 holes with a wrong tee or pick (5, 10, 11, 13, 14, 16, 18)

5: Page 'Gold' (really the Black tips, card 387) tee is a walk-back 67 yds behind the back OSM tee and sits in dense forest on the 2023 NAIP: no tee there.
11: Page 'Gold' (=Black tips) 482 vs card 489: OK. Page 'Black' (=Gold) tee at 447 yds vs Gold card 482: forward tee; the OSM tee at ~476 yds fits.
13: Page 'Gold' (=Black tips) is on a lidar pad 14 yds behind the back OSM tee, 427 vs card 432: plausible unmapped tips box, acceptable.
14: Page 'Gold' (=Black tips) tee at 360 yds vs card 406: an OSM tee at ~402 yds fits. Page 'Black' (=Gold) 313 vs Gold card 362: the OSM tee at ~354 fits.
16: Page 'Gold' (=Black tips) 402 vs golfify Black 439 (AllSquare and OpenGolfAPI both say 401 from the back; the longest OSM tee is ~396): probably OK at the tips, golfify 439 doubtful.
18: Page 'Gold' (=Black tips) 554 vs 556 OK. Page 'Black' (=Gold) 506 vs Gold card 535: the OSM tee at ~533 yds fits.
